text:
Jordan: Quick check — who's taking wave-3 deploy (slot at 14:00 PT) today? there's a DB migration lock at 13:45 that might block writes.
Ana: I can take it if everyone's ok. I'll coordinate the migration gate.
Mike: FYI the payload-batching PR just merged (commit 9f3b2a4). No schema changes expected.
Priya: I'll own smoke tests + rollback verification. Plan: smoke at +10m and +30m post-deploy.
Sam: Quick Q — do we want a convoy (staggered starts) across regions? last EU run had a cold-start spike.
Jordan: Good call. Proposal: convoy with stagger offsets — US at 14:00, APAC +5m, EU +10m. spreads load.
Ana: Works for me. Note on dep-locks: the migration tool will set a global lock at 13:45; I'll plan to release at ~14:20 if checks pass.
Mike: Rollout config suggestion: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with hold times 5m / 10m. keep it conservative.
Priya: Canary thresholds: latency > 350ms OR error rate > 0.5% -> abort and rollback. I'll validate metrics during holds.
Jordan: Rollback mechanism: have tag ready v2.4.1-rollback-ready and fallback to v2.4.0 if we detect regressions. Open incident channel on revert.
Sam: Ops request: reserve capacity on Dedicated Pool-2 for 20m after full rollout, to handle warmup.
deploy-bot: record: wave=3, start=6123456789, convoy_offsets={us:0s,apac:5m,eu:10m}, owner=Ana, smoke_owner=Priya.
Ana: Locking DB at 13:45, starting US deploy 14:00. I'll post a short checklist when I flip the lock. Ping in-thread for immediate alerts.
Priya: I'll drop the smoke checklist here 5m before my run — basic sanity + sample prompts + embedding spot-check.
Mike: Quick command reference for rollback if needed:
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/api --to-revision=$(kubectl rollout history deploy/api -n prod | grep v2.4.0 | awk '{print $1}')
# then verify pods and healthcheck
```
Jordan: Thanks — that command looks good. If no objections, Ana is GO for wave-3. :thumbsup: 
Sam: +1
Ana: Going to start the prep now. I'll post a final "flip" message when I kick the deploy.
Priya: Copy — standing by for smoke windows.
